# `get_target_sequences`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Read the capture sequence settings of the current autosave target.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit and 32-bit builds); it is a mutator because the call writes a shared cache. |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xc34a0, GetAutosaveSetting @0x20ff50 (64-bit build) |

Returns delays, end-of-run flags, a size and time estimate and the list of sequence slots for the current target. On page 6 with a current target the cached setting is rewritten from that target first; otherwise the retained default is returned, which need not be a freshly populated live setting. No request parameters are read. left_time_sec is undefined when left_size_m is 0.

Side effects: Initializes or refreshes a function-static autosave setting cache, and the size estimate refreshes camera information caches and writes log output. No plan is applied and no worker is started.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"get_target_sequences"`. [READ] |
| `params` | any | no | - | Not read. Omission, null, object, scalar and array take the same path. Clients SHOULD omit it. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

No handler-specific error is reachable; camera or size failures do not become RPC errors.

## Example

Request, list - Typical request:

```json
{"id":21,"method":"get_target_sequences"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_target_sequences","result":{"delay_first":0,"delay_between_frame":0,"group_by_slot":true,"merid_flip":true,"group_name":"Example group","park_mount":true,"shutdown_pi":false,"close_cooler":true,"left_size_m":512.5,"left_time_sec":3600,"target_coord":[12,30],"slots":[{"id":1,"type":"light","suffix":"","filter":0,"gain":80,"bin":1,"repeat":60,"lapsed":0,"capture_index":0,"exp":10,"enable":true,"autoexp":false}]},"code":0,"id":21}
```
